name: 真实家庭厨房·杂志级室内摄影（英文长提示词；模型只画环境，冰箱用白底产品图原图贴入）
风格: An interior photograph for an architecture and lifestyle magazine: a real, lived-in family kitchen with a full-height wall of built-in cabinetry in natural oak veneer. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at eye level, 3:4 vertical frame.

光线: Soft overcast daylight enters from a large window on the left, bright and airy, falling off gently toward the back of the room. A slim warm LED strip under the upper cabinets lights only the worktop. Neutral white balance, bright highlights without clipping, soft open shadows that keep material detail.
摆件: On the worktop: a handmade ceramic mug, a loosely folded natural linen cloth and a small plate of fruit, arranged slightly off-centre, suggesting a tidy, considered home that someone actually lives in.

negative_prompt: text, letters, logo, watermark, arrows, refrigerator inside the niche, niche filled, niche shifted, enlarged niche, wrong perspective, leftover flat color blocks, people, 3D render, CGI, plastic look, heavy HDR, oversharpened, low resolution
